calls: One score-free initial mapping request, followed by one compact relevance check of nominated facets when present. Relevance review sees full citizen testimony and definitions, not model positions or expected scores; unsupported nominations are removed before confirmation and scoring. An unassessed route with expressed facets can receive one focused position reread before relevance review. Each request has at most one retry under the shared stage deadline. Citizen confirmation precedes independent LLM facet scoring; Python validates and aggregates. Full prompts are tokenized without truncation. A null numeric result under the independent strength path receives one score-free testimony evaluability check; a positive check triggers bounded numerical reassessment, with both decisions audited. Focused route rereads preserve previously cited facets omitted by the reread, subject to the independent relevance check; explicit revised entries replace earlier entries.
initial_output_format: One compact expressed-facet array and route stance, required primary evidence ID and optional additional IDs. One boolean per nominated facet in relevance review. No numeric scores or generated mapping rationales.
